# filename: parse_heuristic.py
import re

pdf_text = """
Hotels
Neptune's Palace — Rating (out of 5):  — Vacancy: Medium — Pool: Yes — Sample Review: 5 out of 5
Admiral Sturgeon — Rating (out of 5):  — Vacancy: Low — Pool: No — Sample Review: 5 out of 5
Currents — Rating (out of 5):  — Vacancy: High — Pool: No — Sample Review: 4 out of 5
Motels
Sea Escape Inn — Rating (out of 5): 5 — Sample Review: 5 out of 5
Wash Inn — Rating (out of 5): 3 — Sample Review: 3 out of 5
Boulevard Motel — Rating (out of 5): 2 — Sample Review: 2 out of 5
Good Motel — Rating (out of 5): 1 — Sample Review: 1 out of 5
Sea Larva Motel — Rating (out of 5): 0 — Sample Review: 0 out of 5
"""

current_type = None
entries = []
for line in pdf_text.splitlines():
    line = line.strip()
    if not line:
        continue
    if line in {"Hotels", "Motels", "Villas", "Guesthouses", "Inns", "Resorts", "Cottages", "B&Bs"}:
        current_type = line
        continue
    # Extract name (text before the dash)
    name = line.split("—")[0].strip()
    # Extract rating number after "Rating (out of 5):"; if absent, default to 0
    m = re.search(r"Rating \(out of 5\):\s*([0-5])", line)
    rating = float(m.group(1)) if m else 0.0
    entries.append({"Name": name, "Type": current_type, "Rating": rating})

import pandas as pd
final_df = pd.DataFrame(entries)
print(final_df)
print("\nCounts by Type:\n", final_df['Type'].value_counts())
